issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:   

time-shifting cause  container created in the feature.
when time shift back to now a days, kubelet will failed to created new container.

```s
Apr 20 20:25:19 master kubelet[3580]: E0420 20:25:19.876407    3580 remote_runtime.go:200] CreateContainer in sandbox "f9dc950f0fdd6aadc8952849622ab6ae8ff6195a73905cdc90dadbf13f80dad2" from
 runtime service failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Error response from daemon: Conflict. The container name "/k8s_echo_echo-58d57fb7c-nrl5j_default_a9365d2a-d8cd-4a9d-948a-d84e064116
84_2" is already in use by container "0eaf56444980451ed2ca3f99bf09a571b61a6023f36519fc35ad3fe6375d5449". You have to remove (or rename) that container to be able to reuse that name.
```

**What you expected to happen**:

kubelet should create container

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:

**Anything else we need to know?**:

**Environment**: 
- Kubernetes version (use `kubectl version`): 1.15.1

kubelet sort containers by create timestame which is the root cause of the problem.
sort by `Metadata.Attempt`  sames to solve this problem.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/1c62d2c368919de8bba93ea4706632bd2ac8027c/pkg/kubelet/kuberuntime/helpers.go#L52-L62


https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/d4bfcd1fda63aeb984eb0d83f5cc58768e359679/pkg/kubelet/dockershim/naming.go#L58-L79


/sig node
